structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Core solar/storage recovery provides the present base while data-center power is optionality, not required proof of current recovery.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Module-level and inverter architectures compete with alternative string/central inverter and storage-control designs.

structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Power electronics are necessary infrastructure, but SolarEdge does not uniquely control the solar or data-center power bottleneck.

discovery-weak-signals.name: recovery breadth
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Revenue growth and repeated margin expansion indicate improving operating quality.

discovery-weak-signals.name: AI data-center adjacency
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Management has identified AI data-center power as a high-growth adjacency, creating optionality beyond residential/commercial solar.

adversarial-red-team.name: turnaround durability
adversarial-red-team.basis: Six consecutive quarters of year-over-year margin expansion strengthen the recovery case, while GAAP profitability and full-cycle durability remain incomplete.

adversarial-red-team.name: adjacency confidence
adversarial-red-team.basis: Data-center power should not be capitalized as an established growth engine before customer and revenue evidence exists.

expectations-execution.name: execution conversion
expectations-execution.basis: Revenue, margin and operating-loss trends provide measurable conversion of turnaround claims.

expectations-execution.name: new-market execution
expectations-execution.basis: Data-center power is strategically attractive but remains less proven than the core inverter/energy-storage franchise.

items.risk: The recovery follows a severe prior downturn; absolute GAAP profitability remains incomplete.
GAAP net loss persisted in Q2, so the turnaround should not be represented as fully complete.
A successor bottleneck can shift from inverter availability to end-market financing, grid interconnection, storage economics or customer acquisition.
Solar demand cyclicality and inventory corrections can reverse operating leverage.
Competitive power-electronics alternatives can constrain pricing and share recovery.
